object.attr: as implemented: SCALING.md measured 101 s at 1,000 objects on a mostly idle reference machine with the installer's build. 1,000 objects is the recommended document size, and export time sets it. 150 s leaves half of the 300 s stop; the workload is the defined reference document (review Q33, decided on 2026-11-11).
object.description: On the reference machine, Mellon shall export a 1,000-object reference document, from the export start to the exported PDF written, in at most 150 s.
